propositions: Pass-1 ladder entries and model_ladder[0] assignments resolve to bare Anthropic model names even when configured for a different provider, causing a split-brain where provider-specific runs fall back to direct Anthropic calls

MODEL_LADDER's dual role (escalation order and context-window sizing) silently breaks if ladder entries become class names, because substring matching `'standard' in 'bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6'` fails and largest_window_tokens falls through to maximum budget
models_at_or_above() currently returns bare Anthropic model names during Bedrock escalation instead of Bedrock-qualified ids, causing escalation to silently switch providers

Class names (trivial, standard, frontier) must resolve through model_classes.resolve_model_string at call sites: config.resolve_model, batch-runner ladder expansion, and workflow/runners.py:120, with config.py importing model_classes lazily in-function to avoid a module-level import cycle

MODEL_LADDER must remain unchanged (bare names + windows), and largest_window_tokens must be byte-for-byte unchanged; models_at_or_above maps at-or-above rungs through class config while preserving bare-name returns when no classes are configured
Literal model ids in ladder entries and step config must round-trip unchanged through resolve_model_string for backward compatibility
